scope: Post-integration static Compiler traceability against released CA-SL v1alpha5 and IngressCatalog v1alpha1. No row is CI PASS or product qualification. 37 rows are implemented+tested by executable Go tests in this repository; 19 remain Compiler-static deferred; 45 are Skill/Host/Runtime/Integration obligations, not Compiler-owned static obligations; 1 is specification-only. The register covers all 36 EW and 66 IN cases. Real Owner artifacts, Integration wire conformance and 5GC/MAS qualification remain NOT_QUALIFIED.
